name: BlueskyMenuUITest
options:
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "17.0"
targets:
  TestHost:
    type: application

    sources:
      - App

      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.blueskymenutest.host
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
  MenuUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - UITests
    dependencies:
      - target: TestHost
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.blueskymenutest.uitests
      TEST_TARGET_NAME: TestHost
schemes:
  BlueskyMenuUITest:
    build:
      targets:
        TestHost: all
        MenuUITests: [test]
    test:
      targets:
        - MenuUITests
EOF
cat > App/App.swift <<'EOF'
import UIKit

@main
class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    func application(_ application: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool { true }
}
EOF
cat > UITests/MenuUITests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class MenuUITests: XCTestCase {
    func testOpenBlueskyMenu() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "xyz.blueskyweb.app")
        app.activate()
        let hamburger = app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.075, dy: 0.095))
        hamburger.tap()
        sleep(2)
    }
}
EOF
